_comment: Lead-time sensitivity (Pillar et al. 2016, Fig. 1): ECCO4 prescribed-flux ocean from 1993-01, 365 days (4380 steps), AMOC averaged over the last 30 days, gradients wrt the monthly stress, heat and freshwater flux slices (leads ~1-12 months); full adjoint; no Taylor check (each evaluation is ~30 min).
